1.text: **Dropout**, test point `V_in = V_out + dropout`, binding corners `{ss, sf}` at 125 °C (DR-003). Current verdict and freshness: see the characterization report.

2.text: **Line regulation / Load regulation** have no dedicated sky130 porting note beyond the ratified numbers themselves. Current verdicts: see the characterization report.

3.text: **Load transient**, over the ratified C_out/ESR window (0.33–4.7 µF, 0–500 mΩ, no minimum ESR, ceramic-stable — DR-002). Current verdict: see the characterization report.

4.text: **PSRR and Stability** both have a topology-level root cause and a named superseding proposal, unlike the other rows: [`DR-007`](spec/decision-records/DR-007-psrr-stability-vs-iq.md) (`proposed`) recommends PSRR ≥ 18 dB @ 1 kHz / ≥ 28 dB @ 100 kHz and a Stability floor scoped to `I_load ≥ 1 mA` only — not adopted here, and pending its own ratification via the two-key market-comparison mechanism. PSRR is measured at both ratified load points with the `ac` linearization point seeded per `sim/README.md`'s initial-condition contract (#179); the 0 mA end of Stability is the binding, unresolved gap. Current verdicts and freshness: see the characterization report.

5.text: **Iq** is set by [`DR-009`](spec/decision-records/DR-009-iq-budget.md) (`proposed`; fresh ratification pending under #301 — DR-009 does not ratify itself). The number comes from gf180-ldo parity, checked against a sky130 device-fact budget and public comps, not from the measured result. It closes the item DR-003/DR-006 left open. No named binding corner (DR-004 caveat). Current verdict: see the characterization report; DR-009's Consequences discuss the non-regulating DC operating points among failing corners.

6.text: **Current limit, Startup/soft-start, and Enable/shutdown** — current verdicts and freshness: see the characterization report.

7.text: **Thermal**'s fault-only 150 °C/135 °C trip/reset backstop is internally-generated (not `VREF`, not a bandgap), auto-restart, per DR-005; it sits outside this repo's characterized 125 °C temperature ceiling and is PVT-loose. Current verdict: see the characterization report.

Area.target: < 0.1 mm² total core area, pass FET included, excluding pads and sealring

Current limit.target: constant-current (brickwall) clamp, window TBD over PVT; never engages for I_load ≤ 50 mA; survives continuous Vout = 0 short at Vin_max (note 6)

Enable / shutdown.target: shutdown Iq < 3 µA worst corner; disabled output = pass device fully off, no active discharge; Vin→Vout leakage ≤ 1 µA (note 6)

Input.stretch: 5 V flavor as a separate follow-on variant

Iq (excl. load current).stretch: < 10 µA — subordinate to DR-002's C_out/ESR window; not to be bought back by reintroducing a minimum ESR
Iq (excl. load current).target: < 30 µA at no load **and** at full load (50 mA), every PVT corner; Iq = total VIN current minus load current, EN asserted (note 5)

Line regulation.target: < 5 mV/V over 2.97–3.63 V, at 1 mA and 50 mA (note 2)

Load.target: 0–50 mA (0 mA = no external load; feedback divider is the only inherent preload)

Load transient.target: 1↔50 mA step, ~1 µs edges: peak excursion ≤ 150 mV, recover to ±1% in ≤ 20 µs, over the ratified C_out/ESR window (note 3)

Output.target: 1.8 V ±2% (fixed; divider as a unit-resistor string)

Output noise.stretch: µVrms row if a consumer asks
Output noise.target: not specified — waived unless a consumer states a requirement

PSRR.target: > 50 dB @ 1 kHz and > 20 dB @ 100 kHz, at 1 mA (light-load, binding) and at 50 mA (note 4)

Stability.target: stable 0–50 mA over the ratified C_out/ESR window; PM ≥ 45°, GM ≥ 10 dB worst corner (note 4)

Startup / soft-start.target: monotonic into any load 0–50 mA and any C_out in the stability window; controlled ramp; inside ±2% within a few ms of enable; overshoot ≤ +2% (note 6)

Thermal.target: continuous worst-case dissipation set by Vin_max × I_load; short-circuit ceiling set by the current limit; specified to Tj ≤ 125 °C (rated-operation ceiling, unchanged); θJA delegated to package/integration (note 7)
